_readme: Functions granted EXECUTE to `authenticated` that check-dormant-rpcs.mjs must not fail on.
An entry is a debt, not an absolution. The gate exists because this codebase repeatedly shipped
complete server work no button could reach (BACKLOG.md G1-G15). Delete the entry when the caller
lands -- do not delete the entry to make the gate quiet.
THE NUMBER HAS BEEN WRONG THREE TIMES, each time because this script read SQL badly:
1. It never looked for `drop function`, so it reported a function a migration had removed.
2. It treated a migration COMMENT as a call site, so naming a function in prose excused it.
3. It read line by line, so in a grant naming several functions only the first line carried
the keywords and every later one read as a bare call. That hid 20 functions at once.
Each fix raised the count. 'Zero' was never true; 21 is the number as of the statement-level fix.
Everything below is verified against the live catalog with a word-boundary search, not against
this script's own parsing -- pg_proc bodies, RLS policies, views and triggers, plus client and
edge-function source. Each has an open G15.x row.

unassign_organization_release_cohort.reason: Restored by 20260804160000 to close the one-way door 20260802030000 left behind. The statement-level gate fix has since shown its counterpart `assign_organization_release_cohort` is equally uncalled, so the whole cohort mechanism is intact and unreachable rather than half-wired. Both need the surface that migration deliberately deleted; see G15.1.

assign_organization_release_cohort.reason: G12.1's counterpart, and dormant for the same reason: the pilot cohort console that called both was deleted on purpose by 20260802030000. Neither side has a caller; the mechanism is intact and unreachable.

revoke_integration_api_credential.reason: An issued integration API credential cannot be revoked from anywhere. The same one-way door closed for survey-packet guest grants in G9, on a credential that authenticates machine access.

rotate_integration_api_credential.reason: Nor rotated, so a credential suspected of leaking can only be left in place.

rotate_integration_webhook_secret.reason: The signing secret a webhook consumer verifies against cannot be rotated.

deactivate_integration_webhook_endpoint.reason: A webhook endpoint can be created but never switched off, so deliveries continue to a URL nobody controls any more.

rotate_scim_connection_credential.reason: The SCIM provisioning credential cannot be rotated, which is the standing remediation when a directory integration is compromised.

get_scim_connection_registry.reason: Takes no arguments and returns the SCIM connection registry. Nothing lists SCIM connections at all, so the rotation above has no surface to be offered from either.

link_sso_identity_subject.reason: Binds an SSO provider subject to a profile with a stated link method. Without it an SSO identity that fails to auto-match cannot be attached by an administrator.

grant_identity_break_glass.reason: Emergency elevated access with a requester, a ticket reference, a reason and a mandatory expiry -- carefully built, and impossible to invoke.

revoke_identity_break_glass.reason: And impossible to end early, which is the half that matters most.

record_training_attendance.reason: Records attendance for a class registration with check-in/out times and evidence. Distinct from the class-attendance path already wired in G6; this one is the registration-level record.

approve_training_session_completion.reason: Approves a training session's completion with a reason. Nothing offers the approval, so the state it grants cannot be reached.

record_resident_service_task.reason: Records a service task response with supervisor notification and an optional second staff member. The offline draft sync path writes these; the online path does not call it.

retract_clinical_progress_note.reason: A clinical progress note cannot be retracted. A note entered on the wrong resident stands, because retraction is the audited path and it has no caller.

save_report_schedule.reason: A report definition can be built and run but never scheduled, so recurring delivery cannot be set up.

set_hris_import_row_decision.reason: Accepts or rejects one row of an HRIS import against an employee. The import runs are creatable (G10) but individual row decisions cannot be recorded.

get_regulatory_rule_snapshot.reason: Returns a rule as it stood on a date. Nothing asks, so 'what did the rule say when this happened' has no answer in the product.

record_regulatory_shadow_run.reason: Records a shadow evaluation of a candidate rule version against a cohort -- the mechanism for testing a regulation change before it binds.

reconcile_regulatory_shadow_difference.reason: Resolves one difference a shadow run found, with a rationale and an evidence checksum. No shadow run can be recorded, so no difference can exist to reconcile.

record_regulatory_fixture_result.reason: Records a regulatory engine fixture result for a given engine version. The conformance harness has no entry point.
